title: Report incomplete PR file inventories even without path matches
body:
## Summary

Path overlap reports can silently omit a known incomplete file inventory when none of its available paths match. A live read of PR #376 returned `files: null`; the existing collector correctly marked it `truncated: true`, but a fresh cache with matching head/base produced zero path hits, no warnings and no visible inventory gap.

Expose the sorted, unique PR numbers in `coverage.pr_files.truncated_prs` and warn independently of matching paths or `--limit`. Preserve `truncated` in combined term-and-path matches and their text rendering. `complete_pagination` continues to describe list paging; the documentation now explicitly separates that from completeness of each PR's file inventory. Fetching, cache contents, endpoint checks and mathematical sources are unchanged.

## Test plan

Validation on macOS with CPython 3.12.14:

- [x] 44 focused overlap/file/discussion tests pass, including five new actual subprocess CLI regressions covering no-hit fresh/offline caches, unavailable and short inventories, duplicate rows, result limits, combined matches, text output and a complete-empty control. The CLI fixtures disable executable lookup and preserve the cache bytes.
- [x] The new regressions fail against the unchanged base helper. Replaying the PR #376-derived cache after the fix exposes `truncated_prs: [376]` and the warning while retaining zero matches.
- [x] `git diff --check` passes.

The full mathematical/selected replay and a full live file-index refresh were not run.

```sh
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_pr*.py' -v
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_overlap_*.py' -v
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_discussion_batch*.py' -v
```

Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. Scope refines verifier engineering to a concrete coordination-tool coverage failure. Targeted all-state PR searches, the current #1166 handoffs, and complete #1200 comments/replies found no same-scope follow-up; this is bounded metadata coverage, not a novelty guarantee.

Credit Douglas Colkitt's overlap/cache helper, Aaron Wang/navinor's #1623 path index, ywz65's #2517 continuation paging, Arham Tahir's #3104 head binding and Tekalign's #3141 base binding. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No kappa or selected-frontier change.
